1.title: Why the Cloud Transforms Business
1.text: Welcome to Module one: Why the Cloud Transforms Business. It covers the exam area one. Digital transformation with Google Cloud. Each part of this module comes from the study notes of the same name, so you can read the notes after you watch.

1.title: What You Will Learn
1.text: By the end of this module you will be able to do five things. one point one Explain why and how the cloud is revolutionizing businesses: define cloud, agentic A I, infrastructure, digital transformation, open source and open standard. Explain the benefits of cloud technology to digital transformation. Describe the drivers and challenges of digital transformation. Recognize Google Cloud's top differentiators. Practice with exam-style questions and a recall check.

1.title: Where This Fits in the Exam
1.text: Here is where this module sits in the exam. Exam area: one. Digital transformation with Google Cloud (about eighteen percent). Exam format: ninety minutes and fifty to sixty multiple-choice questions. Validated against: the official Google Cloud Digital Leader exam guide.

1.title: Key terms
1.text: Key terms. Cloud. Computing resources delivered over the internet and paid for by use. Infrastructure. The servers, storage and networks that run applications. Digital transformation. Using digital technology to change how a business works and serves customers, not only moving old systems. Agentic A I. A I agents that reason, plan and take actions toward a goal with limited human steps. Open source. Software whose code is public and can be used and changed by anyone. Open standard. A public specification that different products can follow to work together. Exam tip: Digital transformation is a business change, not just a technology move. The cloud is a tool for it.

1.title: Benefits of cloud technology
1.text: Benefits of cloud technology. The figure shows this: Cloud benefits and what they mean for a business.

1.title: Benefits of cloud technology, continued
1.text: Benefits of cloud technology. Scalability. Grow or shrink resources to match demand. Cost-effectiveness. Pay for what you use; no large upfront hardware purchase. Agility and speed. Launch new products and tests in days, not months. Flexibility. Choose the right tools and change them. Enhanced security. Provider-scale security and built-in controls. Global reach and high availability. Serve users close to where they are, with resilient services. Data-driven insights. Analytics and A I on all of your data. Strategic value and focus. Staff spend time on the business, not on running data centers.

1.title: Drivers and challenges of digital transformation
1.text: Drivers and challenges of digital transformation. Customer expectations for digital, fast service. Legacy systems that are hard to change. Competition from digital-first companies. Skills gaps and cultural resistance. Cost pressure and need for efficiency. Security, privacy and compliance concerns. New data and A I opportunities. Data silos and poor data quality. Need to scale and enter new markets. Budget and unclear business case. Not adopting new technology carries risks: falling behind competitors, higher costs, slower response, security exposure from old systems and losing talent and customers. Exam tip: Legacy systems, skills and culture are the classic challenges. Customer expectations and competition are the classic drivers.

1.title: What makes Google Cloud different
1.text: What makes Google Cloud different. World-leading A I. A I research and Gemini models built into the products. Openness and interoperability. Open source and open standards; multicloud and hybrid choices; no lock-in. A I Hypercomputer. Purpose-built A I infrastructure for training and serving A I. A I-ready data platform. Big Query and other data products that connect data to A I. Security. Secure by design with defense in depth. Global network. Google's own network that carries Google services worldwide. Exam tip: Openness means choice: open source, open standards and the ability to run in more than one cloud. It is how Google Cloud answers vendor lock-in.

1.title: Practice Question 1
1.text: Question one. A bank uses the cloud mainly to launch new customer features faster than its competitors. Which benefit of cloud technology does this show? The four options are on the screen. The answer is D: Agility and speed to market. Launching new products quickly is the agility and speed benefit.

1.title: Practice Question 2
1.text: Question two. A company moves its servers to the cloud but changes nothing about how it works or serves customers. Which statement is correct? The four options are on the screen. The answer is C: This only moves technology, so transformation is limited. Digital transformation changes how the business works; a technology move alone does not.

1.title: Practice Question 3
1.text: Question three. Which challenge is most typical of an organization with old, hard-to-change systems? The four options are on the screen. The answer is A: Legacy systems that are hard to modernize. Legacy systems are a classic challenge; customer demand and competition are drivers.

1.title: Practice Question 4
1.text: Question four. A retailer needs more computing power during a holiday sale and less afterwards, paying only for what it uses. Which benefits apply? The four options are on the screen. The answer is A: Scalability and cost-effectiveness. Scaling up and down with pay-for-use pricing shows scalability and cost-effectiveness.

1.title: Practice Question 5
1.text: Question five. Which is a Google Cloud differentiator related to avoiding vendor lock-in? The four options are on the screen. The answer is B: Openness and interoperability with open standards. Openness and interoperability, including open source and open standards, give customers choice.

1.title: Practice Question 6
1.text: Question six. What is agentic A I? The four options are on the screen. The answer is D: A I agents that reason, plan and act toward a goal. Agentic A I uses agents that reason, plan and take actions to reach goals.

1.title: Recall Check 1
1.text: Recall check one. Say each answer out loud before you listen to mine. Question one. What is digital transformation? Answer: Using digital technology to change how a business works and serves customers. Question two. Name two benefits of the cloud. Answer: For example scalability and cost-effectiveness. Question three. Name a driver of transformation. Answer: For example customer expectations or competition.

1.title: Recall Check 2
1.text: Recall check two. Say each answer out loud before you listen to mine. Question four. Name a challenge of transformation. Answer: For example legacy systems, skills gaps or culture. Question five. What does open standard mean? Answer: A public specification that products follow to work together. Question six. What is A I Hypercomputer? Answer: Google Cloud's purpose-built infrastructure for A I.

1.title: Module Recap
1.text: Here is the recap. Cloud: resources over the internet, paid by use. Benefits: scalability, cost, agility, flexibility, security, reach, insights, focus. Drivers or challenges: customers and competition or legacy, skills, culture, security, silos. Google Cloud: A I, openness, A I Hypercomputer, A I-ready data, security, global network.
